title: The Worst Attitude To Have After You Crash Your Car
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 23rd, 2024. A couple called 911 in regards to a drunk driver who was swerving on the highway until she crashed. When the officer approached her she was extremely argumentative and refused to listen to simple instructions, forcing the officer to put her in the back of his squad car. The 23-year-old even refused to complete field sobriety tests due to how argumentative she was. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
